answer: For a marketplace where a raven inspects marble bridges through a prism sensor, issue each agent a one-time task ticket bound to its public key, epoch, and a random nonce. The ticket commits to a data shard; submission must include a signature and sampled raw evidence. Validators recompute the commitment and reject duplicate shards or reused tickets, while proven fabrication burns the posted bond. Creating n aliases therefore requires n bonds and n independent shards; copied keys add no reward and expand exposure to verifiable slashing.
